rule: On an observed entity update, signed horizontal and vertical velocity units divide by 16 (toward zero); the candidate position resolves independently against verified room-background bounds. No RNG decision or actor-update scheduling is inferred.
limits: This models one *supplied* source enemy-update event, only for the measured kind range, room and three velocities. It does not choose random velocity, decide when to update, move other enemies, apply player contact/damage or generate an autonomous native enemy.
